newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley calls 8-3/4 pct cum pref.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley calls 8-3/4 pct cum pref.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc said Wednesday it has called for redemption on May 30 all 750,000 outstanding shares of its 8-3/4 percent cumulative preferred stock, no par value, and authorized the Bank of New York to simultaneously call for redemption all corresponding depository shares, each representing 1/8 of a share of the 8-3/4 percent cumulative preferred stock at a redemption price of $200.00 per share of 8-3/4 percent cumulative preferrred stock (equal to $25.000 per depositary share) which reflects the stated value of $200 per share of 8-3/4 percent cumulative preferred stock.
As of May 30, 1997, there will be no accrued dividends with respect to the 8-3/4 percent preferred stock.
